target_audience: garage DIY and RV maintenance buyers
parts_summary: 6-inch stitched cotton buffing wheel, concentric stitched rings, center hole, flat washer, nut
installation_method: spindle passes through center hole, flat washer and nut secure the wheel
not_for: wool wheel, felt wheel, synthetic fur wheel, grinding stone
safety_notes: keep hands clear of spinning outer circumference, secure with flat washer and nut
source_description: 6-inch stitched cotton buffing wheel with 1-inch thickness and 1/2-inch center hole. Approximately 70 ply, natural off-white cotton, concentric stitched rings. Spindle passes through center hole. Flat washer and nut secure the wheel. Polishing occurs at the outer cotton circumference. Product must not become wool, felt, synthetic fur or grinding stone.
